title: Deal evidence readiness — what is blocking review?
description: Synthetic enterprise deal-desk example for Revenue Operations. Reconciles separate CRM, quote, security and finance records against an explicitly identified quote and delivery scope. A positive result means evidence readiness under this illustrative policy; it is not permission to sign or a prediction that the customer will buy.

decision.intent: Establish whether evidence for the current deal, quote and delivery scope is sufficient for the accountable owner to review, and expose missing records or policy exceptions.
decision.question: Is the evidence for this deal ready for owner review?

evidenceRequirements.description: CRM record naming the opportunity, current quote revision and delivery scope.
Quote showing the same scope, terms revision, annual value and discount as the review request.
Security approval or refusal for the same opportunity, quote revision and delivery scope.
Finance approval or refusal covering the same quote, scope, terms revision, value and discount.

sources.title: Synthetic deal evidence policy v0.2.0

citation.excerpt: Records must match the reviewed opportunity, quote revision and delivery scope. Finance must cover the current terms, value and discount. Missing, inaccessible or mismatched evidence cannot clear the deal. A positive result means evidence readiness for owner review.

sources.rights: Original synthetic demonstration content. Not OpenText policy.

outcomes.label: Evidence ready for owner review
outcomes.description: The declared records match the submitted deal, quote revision, scope and commercial terms, and satisfy this demo policy. The accountable owner still decides whether to proceed.

outcomes.label: Commercial review required
outcomes.description: Security and finance clear the proposal, but discount above 20% requires Deal Desk review.

outcomes.label: Hold — resolve the blocker
outcomes.description: A known approval or commercial validity check prevents readiness.

rules.description: Complete matching approvals within standard commercial policy
rules.rationale: The asserted evidence satisfies the reviewed gate; the owner remains responsible for any signature decision.

rules.description: Cleared proposal above the standard discount limit
rules.rationale: Cleared proposal above the standard discount limit; this is a synthetic policy recommendation.
Known security or finance refusal; this is a synthetic policy recommendation.

exceptions.description: Nonstandard terms require a person even if finance and security are clear.

escalation.message: The Deal Desk owner coordinates the named evidence owner. Inspect the retained source diagnosis: obtain missing reviews, correct the exact quote or scope, or route nonstandard terms to Legal. No notification or signature is sent.

authors: Codex — synthetic demo prepared for the maintainer
